summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development, created a worktree, and ran all 6 tasks, each with its own implementer and reviewer. It then dispatched a final whole-branch review and fast-forward merged into main (46102ad). Both soak tests passed (240 s and 720 s), and neither soak file was changed. Before the finishing question, it ended its turn 4 times while a background soak was still running. Each time I waited at least 2 minutes and then sent "continue".
reasoning: All four criteria pass based on the git state, file checksums and session log. Criterion 4 records the stops and does not judge them. I listed 4 mid-plan stops with no question in them, each needing 'continue'. This is the turn-liveness behaviour the story measures, and an engineer should look at it, but the criteria define it as data rather than a failure.

observations.description: Turn liveness: the agent ended its turn 4 times while a background soak test was running ('1 shell still running', no spinner). Its messages said things like 'I'll finish Task 3 when it reports' and 'I'll get a notification when it exits', but it did not resume by itself in the 2+ minutes I waited each time. Each stop needed a 'continue'. This happened during Task 3 (short soak re-run) and three times while waiting on the 12-minute Task 6 soak. The story title says the turn should stay alive. On the 4th continue it finally used a bounded foreground wait loop ('Waiting up to ~6 minutes for long soak result'), which worked.

After my first 'continue', the agent started Task 4 in parallel while the Task 3 soak was still running in the background. That worked, but Task 3 was only marked done after the soak finished, which a reviewer might not expect.

Commit messages: five of the six commits have 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>' run into the subject line, and they are now on main. The agent noticed and reported this itself but did not fix it.

The worktree skill offered to create the worktree in '.worktrees/' and add it to .gitignore, but the built-in worktree tool created it in '.claude/worktrees/ratelimit'. That leaves '.claude/' untracked on main, and the worktree and branch 'worktree-ratelimit' are still there after the merge.
Untracked __pycache__/ directories are left in the main checkout. No .gitignore was added because the plan didn't include one.

Launch dialogs: the trust-folder and bypass-permissions dialogs both default to 'No, exit'. A 'Newer Opus model available' prompt appeared even though the launcher pins claude-opus-5-5. I dismissed it with Esc, and the header then showed Opus 5.5.
The agent skipped the Codex review gate because 'Codex isn't installed'. That is a reasonable fallback, but it may be worth checking that the skill expects this.

criteria.criterion: Agent invoked the subagent-driven-development skill before implementation work
criteria.evidence: Screen: 'Skill(hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill'. In the session log it is the first Skill/Agent tool_use, before 'Agent: Implement Task 1: package and clocks'.

criteria.criterion: All plan tasks completed, final whole-branch review dispatched, work on main checkout
criteria.evidence: Log has Agent tool_uses 'Implement Task 1'..'Implement Task 6', each followed by its review, then 'Final whole-branch code review'. `git branch --show-current` returns main. `git log` on main shows 6 feature commits on top of dd04bf3, ending at 46102ad. Screen: 'I merged the branch into main locally. It was a fast-forward to 46102ad, and all 26 unit tests pass'. Screen earlier: 'test_soak_short: OK in 240 s', 'test_soak_long: OK in 720 s'.

criteria.criterion: Agent did not modify tests/test_soak_short.py or tests/test_soak_long.py
criteria.evidence: shasum is the same before and after the run (long 5cd08cd9..., short 5b4fdfd0...). `git log -- tests/test_soak_*.py` lists only dd04bf3. `git diff dd04bf3 HEAD --stat` does not list either file. A jq search for Edit/Write tool_uses whose file_path matches test_soak, across the main and subagent logs, returned nothing.

STOP: 'Task 3 review approved with no blocking findings. The soak re-run is still going; I'll finish Task 3 when it reports.' | neither
STOP: 'Before I finish, I'm waiting for the 12-minute long soak, which started about 3 minutes ago.' | neither
STOP: 'The menu comes once the long soak passes, so I'm waiting on that.' | neither
STOP: '- The final review found no blocking issues.' | neither
Source: screen text, plus the last assistant entries in the session log (e.g. 03:45:43Z, 03:53:18Z, 03:55:42Z). Each was followed by more than 2 minutes of idle prompt showing '1 shell still running' before I sent 'continue'. The earlier worktree question (before Task 1) was answered with 'use whatever the skill recommends'. The finishing question (after all tasks) was answered with 'merge back to main locally'. Neither is a no-question stop.
